title: CommissionAdjusted
description: A commission charge amount was waived or changed (for example a PROVIDER_LED_EVIDENCE dispute was approved). A full reversal stays COMMISSION_CHARGE_REVERSED. Carries the decision that explains it. No patient data.

reason.description: Machine reason, e.g. PROVIDER_LED_EVIDENCE, GOODWILL_WAIVER, POLICY_CORRECTION.

decisionRef.description: Id of the Kiorex AttributionDecision (or the Clinic CommissionDecision) that explains the outcome. Additive in 1.10.0.

origin.description: Commission-relevant acquisition origin decided by the Kiorex attribution function (additive in 1.10.0). Absent = UNATTRIBUTED and today's rules apply.

policyVersion.description: Version id of the ATTRIBUTION_POLICY config that was ACTIVE at decision time. Additive in 1.10.0.

aggregateType.description: Injected by the Kiorly outbox; mirrors the envelope field.

aggregateId.description: Injected by the Kiorly outbox; mirrors the envelope field.
